findings.finding: V1 CI counts lacked job/workflow identity.
V1 stale quiescence receipts did not establish current idle or reader identity.
V1 approved order source had check/use race.
V1 process-local single-use and dry run lacked durable crash reconciliation.
V1 strict failure occurred before downstream report checks.
V1 state checks occurred outside publication lock.

counterargument: Substituting the prior verifier crosses a strict protocol boundary and could conceal an unrecognized failure; frozen report identity and explicit failed-format resolution mitigate only when every surrounding guard is effective. No source examined yet establishes an explicit human approval requirement for this bounded D0 proposal.
limits: Static review of specified draft; prior watchdog familiarity disclosed; no proposal authorship. Evidence snapshots are historical, not live CI qualification. No recovery, activation, acceptance, merge, full 007 or MVP/human gate claim. DHA NONE.

findings: V2 improves the six V1 guards: exact workflow/job/ordered steps; frozen bytes usable by validate_order via read_bytes/is_file/is_symlink/name/suffix; immutable attempt before writes and no dry run; unique order/report and new-file graph; locked rechecks and finally restoration. It leaves normal S verification untouched.

current_quiet accepts historical strings anywhere in the last 28 pane lines: Goal achieved and Worked for can refer to a previous goal while the current turn is active and its Pursuing goal line has scrolled out. Consequently it does not prove present idle; stale retirement quiet boolean also does not repair this. Require authoritative current terminal/turn state tied to current goal/pane and a fresh attributable observation at boundary; fail closed on ambiguity, preserving human settings.

Old PID absence and cooperative reader locks reduce risk, but are not a general proof that no other noncooperative reader exists. Root must reconcile actual original process identity and signal state with fresh evidence; no FIFO read or replay.

Remote state is checked during remote_transition before final local checks, not atomically with remote changes; immediately recheck exact head/main/PR and required CI as close as possible to publication and abort on observed change. External concurrent changes remain an operational limitation; review again before any subsequent signal or merge.
v2_assessment.scope: Static only. No actual receipt, final order or exact approval exists for assessment; these require Root review. Neither graph reconciliation nor successful publication accepts rejected R. Strict verifier restoration is in finally; exceptions before publication propagate. Journal crash recovery requires separate review, no replay. No routine human approval requirement found.

v3_assessment.analysis: V3 replaces historical pane string alone with current footer, pinned process/start/parent/cwd and thread FDs, goal identity and complete status, stable bounded lifecycle ending in pinned completed turn. This addresses V2 stale-tail finding subject to the evidence being current at operation. Remote exact head/main/PR and required CI rechecked near writes; no distributed atomicity claimed. FrozenOrder supports validator read_bytes/is_file/is_symlink/name/suffix; strict callback restored finally; durable journal prevents replay and S normal strict checks remain unchanged.
v3_assessment.conditions: Root must review exact final S order/approval and actual records, reconfirm live state and no changed head before signal; abort on observed change. Interrupted attempt requires separate reconciliation. Review is not authorization to execute, report acceptance, CI qualification or merge. Current evidence is a snapshot and is not an App Server status claim. Strongest counterargument remains exceptional substitution of strict predecessor verifier; scope and independent exact graph checks limit its effect. DHA NONE.
